ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75-80% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edges, tips, and central vertical axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric blobs occupy the primary surface of both lobes. These are bounded by a continuous black perimeter along the trailing edge and an irregular black vertical bridge at the central notch. Small, low-density black focal spots are scattered within the white fields, particularly on the lower interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a deep V-shape with a sharp vertex; the calculated interior angle is approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration detected along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe displays higher pixel-amplitude variations with jagged, irregular peaks, while the left lobe shows a more rhythmic, lower-amplitude scalloped pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curve originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters of white and brown pixels are located at both the left and right distal tips, indicating dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of four distinct, parallel, dark-pigmented vertical lines are visible on the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters at both fluke tips; vertical rake marks on the left lobe; irregular, jagged structural loss on the extreme right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a significantly more bulbous and asymmetrical pixel texture compared to the left lobe tip.
